text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — noticed a weird pattern in the FinOps dashboard this morning: Reserved capacity utilization for g5 across eu-west1 dropped from ~72% to ~38% overnight, but per-route cost for the 'chat-stream' model went up 40%. Can someone sanity-check before I escalate? :eyes:

Devin Park: looking now. can you paste the dashboard link? wondering if it's a data lag or real usage shift

Maria Gomez: https://redwood.internal/finops/dashboards/usage?view=per-route — I filtered to last 24h and grouped by model+route. here's the query snippet I ran in the OLAP console:
```
SELECT route, model, SUM(cost) as cost_usd, AVG(utilization) as avg_util
FROM infra_costs
WHERE region='eu-west1' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

Ashwin Rao: FYI we had a maintenance window in eu-west1 at 02:15 UTC, some nodes moved to on-demand temporarily. that could explain the utilization dip and bump in cost. Did you see any route-level failovers?

Maria Gomez: I see a cluster rehome event in the incident log around 02:18 but no automated failovers flagged for chat-stream. Cost spike aligns w/ that timeframe though.

Devin Park: I pulled reserved instance utilization from cloud billing — RI utilization dropped to 41% between 02:00-04:00, and on-demand line items increased. attaching short paste of totals:
chat-stream | model-v3 | on-demand +$2,300 | reserved savings lost ~$1,150
(not exact numbers, rough)

Lina Chen: @Devin can you run a per-gpu-hour breakdown by allocation tag? need to see if any team started a big batch job and pinned eu-west1. could be a training job hitting the same pool.

Devin Park: on it. quick SQL: `SELECT allocation_tag, SUM(gpu_hours) FROM gpu_usage WHERE region='eu-west1' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T00:00Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;`

FinOps Bot: Automated note — billing ingestion completed for 2026-03-17. New cost delta: +$9,480 across cloud providers. See /billing/recon for details.

Ashwin Rao: Quick theory: the maintenance forced a handful of long-lived chat-stream sessions to be re-scheduled onto on-demand capacity in eu-west1 because reserved pools were cordoned during reprovision. That would explain both utilization drop and per-route cost rise.

Maria Gomez: OK action items I propose:
- Devin to attach per-allocation GPU-hour delta and cloud bill slice for 02:00-06:00 (ETA 1h)
- Ashwin to confirm maintenance ticket and whether reserved pools were temporarily excluded (ETA 30m)
- Lina to check if any batch/training jobs were scheduled in eu-west1 (ETA 1h)
- I'll add a temporary dashboard alert for reserved utilization <50% and per-route cost >30% change in 1h window

Devin Park: uploaded CSV to the thread: /files/1763501120/gpu-delta-eu-west1.csv — looks like 3 allocation tags spiked: experiments, partner-A, nightly-retrain. experiments accounts for ~62% of the surge.

Lina Chen: nightly-retrain had a cron change yesterday to use eu-west1 for faster spot availability, that explains partner shift. I'll revert region pin for next run and reach out to experiments team to throttle.

Maria Gomez: Great. Also we should consider a reserved rebalancing proposal: move some RI pledges from eu-west1 to us-west2 for lower cost volatility and use smart routing to prefer eu-west1 reserved when available. I'll draft a short proposal for the weekly FinOps sync.

Ashwin Rao: Agreed. For short term, we'll patch the infra to avoid cordoning reserved pools during maintenance windows unless absolutely necessary.

FinOps Bot: Reminder — upcoming committed capacity renewal window in 12 days for us-west2. Suggested action: run utilization forecast job `scripts/commitment_forecast --lookback 90d --region=eu-west1,us-west2`

Maria Gomez: Thanks all. If we can close the immediate tickets and get the CSV reconciled with cloud bills, I'll mark this thread resolved. :thumbsup:
